description: The file defines a custom exception class 'UserAlreadyRegisteredException' extending Spring Security's AuthenticationException, used to signal an attempt to register a user that already exists.

classes.name: UserAlreadyRegisteredException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a user registration attempt is made with an email or username that is already registered. Extends AuthenticationException to integrate with Spring Security's authentication process.

methods.name: UserAlreadyRegisteredException
methods.description: Constructor that takes an error message string and passes it to the superclass constructor.
